game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when goblin raiders strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when goblin raiders strike. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the b value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the royal seal using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the royal seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Royal Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 11.
